name: ContextStream
tagline: Persistent project memory for AI coding agents over hosted MCP
description: ContextStream is a remote MCP server that gives Cline durable project memory: indexed repos, docs, decisions, and tools that persist across sessions. Search, recall, and write against the same shared context instead of re-explaining the codebase every chat. Hosted at https://mcp.contextstream.io/mcp. Sign in with OAuth, or set an optional API key for headless use.

env.name: CONTEXTSTREAM_API_KEY
env.description: Optional API key for headless auth. OAuth sign-in works without it.

install.notes: Cline opens an OAuth flow on first connect. Use CONTEXTSTREAM_API_KEY only if you prefer a static key.
